_README: Back matter. The builder renders a colophon ONLY when a top-level 'colophon' key is present. Filled on B13 from the source's imprint page (data/src/02_chapter61.txt). Numeric character references not required here: render_colophon() HTML-escapes each field, so plain Unicode is written to the UTF-8 XHTML as-is.
